title: Social Clubs & Community Groups Longest Quiet Streak
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bookclub:meeting
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day last(events) as prev_events
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where isnotnull(prev_day) AND prev_events>0 AND events=0 AND gap_days>=2
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_quiet_streak_days
description: Finds the longest multi-day gap with zero social clubs events after activity was previously present.
value: Quiet streaks often mean a broken export, a forgotten subscription, or a habit that silently died — all worth catching early.
implementation: Run daily on `bookclub:meeting` after ingestion; investigate streaks that exceed your normal pause window for this domain.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest quiet streak with supporting timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the longest stretch with no social clubs activity at all so you can tell when a feed or habit went quiet for too long.
